objective: Diagnostico aislado READ_ONLY de la consulta TABLES del Gate3B Custodia. No DDL/DML, no cambios de repositorio, no Produccion.

queries.name: tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, t.object_id FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name IN ('Custodia_Recurso','Custodia_Resguardo','Custodia_Movimiento','Custodia_Devolucion','Custodia_Incidencia','Custodia_CargoPropuesto','RH_UniformePolitica','RH_UniformePoliticaDetalle') ORDER BY t.name;
